summary: Creates a classic Phong-shaded material with ambient, diffuse, specular, emission, texture-map, bump, rim-light, and environment-map controls.

key_params.name: ambdiff
key_params.note: Use diffuse color for ambient color

key_params.name: outputshader
key_params.note: Output generated GLSL shaders to DATs for adaptation

key_concepts: Phong MAT uses the classic Phong shading model, combining ambient, diffuse, and specular reflected light rather than a physically based material model.
Shininess controls the tightness of specular highlights, so it is a core artistic control for plastic, glossy, and matte-looking surfaces.
Color, normal, height, alpha, environment, and rim-light texture workflows multiply or modify the lighting calculation and require valid texture coordinates.
Phong shading is evaluated per pixel and depends on scene lights, geometry normals, and Render TOP settings for visible depth and highlight structure.
Output Shader can export the generated Phong shader variant into Text DATs and a GLSL MAT for custom shader adaptation.
common_gotchas: Phong is light-dependent; without scene lights or suitable Render TOP settings it may look flat or dark.
Specular and shininess values can easily create harsh highlights that do not match PBR assets.
Texture maps need valid UVs or explicit coordinate modes, especially for normal and height maps.
Output Shader can seed custom GLSL MAT work, but generated shader code should be treated as derived material logic.
